kevin_ar: Noticing a vendor charge discrepancy on INV-2026-0783 (vendor: CloudForge). Duplicate line for reserved nodes, ~ $4,200 overcharge. Recommend issuing credit memo.

marta_ops: Can you paste the invoice lines so AR can reconcile?

kevin_ar: Excerpt: ``INV-2026-0783
PO: PO-81290
Line 21: Reserved nodes - 210h @ $10.00 = $2,100
Line 22: Reserved nodes (duplicate) - 210h @ $10.00 = $2,100
Discrepancy: $4,200
```

devin_engineering: We had a metering replay bug in the reserved-node exporter between 2026-06-09 01:00-02:10 UTC. Fixed 06-09 02:15 UTC. See internal AT-2026-5520.

sara_sales: CloudForge is fine with credits historically. Please request a vendor credit memo and ask for confirmation note.

ollie_fin: GL: post to 5100-ADJ (Vendor Adjustments). I approve the $4,200 credit. Please have AR send memo and CC finance.

billing-bot: Created adjustment ADJ-2026-311, credit memo CF-CR-2026-311 queued, status: pending-vendor-ack. Linked ticket AT-2026-5520.

kevin_ar: Sending memo to vendor now. Will update thread when they confirm and provide a timeline for refund vs apply-to-next-invoice.
